verification:
s = {"issue":{"file":"src/orders.ts","report":"Wrong return type"},
     "source":"return String(2);", "feedback":"TS2322",
     "attempts":0,"last_passed":False,"history":[],"max_attempts":3}
first = reactive_agent(s)
assert first["action"] == "generate"
assert "TS2322" in first["prompt"] and "Wrong return type" in first["prompt"]
